# Business Faculty Students' Union (BFSU) — University of Moratuwa
> Institutional public documentation and machine-readable sitemap for language models, academic researchers, and faculty constituents.

## Institutional Profile
- Organization: Business Faculty Students' Union (BFSU)
- Parent Entity: Faculty of Business, University of Moratuwa
- Campus: Katubedda, Moratuwa, Sri Lanka
- Official Faculty URL: https://uom.lk/business

## Academic Departments
- Decision Sciences (Business Analytics): https://uom.lk/ds
- Management of Technology (Business Process Management): https://uom.lk/mot
- Industrial Management (Financial Services Management): https://uom.lk/im
- Undergraduate Studies Division (UGS): https://uom.lk/business/undergraduate-studies

## Core Student Portals
- Moodle LMS: https://online.uom.lk
- Faculty LMS: https://lms.uom.lk
- University Library & Digital Repository: https://uom.lk/lib | http://dl.lib.mrt.ac.lk/
- Examination Portal: https://uom.lk/examinations

## Key Routes & Sitemap
- /: Primary landing page, leadership addresses, latest dispatches, and intake schedules.
- /about: Institutional charter of Faculty of Business, BFSU constitution, current executive council, and past alumni leadership.
- /explore: Multidimensional showcase of student life, academic achievements, events, and undergraduate research.
- /news: Official faculty gazettes, administrative circulars, and student union announcements.
- /links: Architectural campus directory of virtual learning, departments, examination divisions, and welfare services.
- /alumni: Alumni fellowship directory, graduate research cross-linking, and profile portal authentication.
- /research: Undergraduate dissertations and scholarly output linked to UoM Digital Repository.
